How to Play

The basics

  • Guess the hidden word one letter at a time. Tap the on-screen keys or type on a keyboard.
  • A right letter fills in every spot it appears. A wrong letter adds a piece to the hangman.
  • Run out of lives before the word is done and you lose the round.
  • Press Esc, or the menu button, to pause.

Matches and scoring

  • A match is 5 rounds. Win 4 or more for a Gold Cup, 2 or 3 for Silver, fewer for Bronze.
  • You get 10 points per revealed letter. A win adds 25 per life left plus a speed bonus.
  • Everything is multiplied by the difficulty: Easy x1, Normal x1.5, Hard x2, Expert x2.5, Insane x3.
  • Top 5 scores per difficulty go on the Leaderboard.

Game options

  • Daily Word: one hard word a day for everyone, one try only. Solve it on consecutive days for a streak.
  • Timer: a countdown per round (60s on Easy down to 30s on Insane). Time out and you lose. Scores get x1.25.
  • Words: switch from Mixed to a pack: Blocks, Animals, Space or Food.
  • Time: switch the Overworld between day and night.

Coins and power-ups

  • Win rounds to earn coins. Spend them in a round, once each: Reveal a letter (25), +1 Life (40) or Clear 3 wrong letters (30).
  • Spend coins on new hangman figures in Characters, and unlock Achievements as you play.

2-3 Players

  • One player secretly types a word, then passes the device to the others, who guess it in turn.
  • Guessers score as normal. The word setter earns 100 for each guesser who fails.
  • Players take turns setting words. Highest total wins.
